mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS sighting_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cat_id) AS cat_count FROM sightings s JOIN cats c ON c.id = s.cat_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND s.taken_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cats c JOIN sightings s ON s.cat_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND s.embedding IS NOT NULL

WITH ranked_similarities AS ( SELECT c.id AS cat_id, 1 - (s.embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector)) AS similarity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY s.embedding <=> CAST(#{embedding} AS vector), s.id ) AS rank_no FROM cats c JOIN sightings s ON s.cat_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND s.embedding IS NOT NULL ), cat_scores AS ( SELECT cat_id, AVG(similarity) AS raw_similarity FROM ranked_similarities WHERE rank_no <= 2 GROUP BY cat_id ) SELECT c.id AS cat_id, c.name, ( SELECT first_sighting.photo_url FROM sightings first_sighting WHERE first_sighting.cat_id = c.id ORDER BY first_sighting.taken_at, first_sighting.id LIMIT 1 ) AS photo_url, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sightings counted_sightings WHERE counted_sightings.cat_id = c.id ) AS sighting_count, scores.raw_similarity FROM cats c JOIN cat_scores scores ON scores.cat_id = c.id WHERE scores.raw_similarity >= #{minimumSimilarity} ORDER BY scores.raw_similarity DESC, c.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT tags FROM sightings WHERE cat_id = #{catId} AND tags != '' ORDER BY taken_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
